blind.description: An open medieval iron maiden torture device made of dark, aged cast iron or blackened steel. It features an upright, hollow anthropomorphic casing with a stylized helmeted head split across two hinged front door panels that stand open. The interior cavity and inner door faces are lined with sharp, menacing iron spikes. The exterior has reinforced metal bands, heavy rivets, and hinge mechanisms. Surfaces are solid and continuous with no hovering, broken, or melted parts. It stands firmly on an integrated rectangular metal floor plate.
blind.from_above: A hollow U-shaped or semicircular dark metal shell opening toward the bottom of the frame, showing the flat interior floor, inward-pointing spikes along the walls, and the tops of the helmeted doors.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5.0 ft tall (reaches chest-to-shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about half its height in width.
